tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background (Névoa / Grafite).

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, inputs, header.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, hover fills, segmented-control well, neutral badges.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not for controls).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button outlines; 3:1 on bg-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and placeholders on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-subtle (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Índigo. Primary actions, links, active nav, logo body; as text on bg-canvas, bg-surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Lavanda. Decorative only (logo tab, illustrations, cover) — never text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brand-primary text (active nav item, brand badge, info alert).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-primary or brand-primary-hover fill.

tokens.name: logo-tab
tokens.usage: Logo: the tab on top of the wallet.

tokens.name: logo-clasp
tokens.usage: Logo: the clasp — Lavanda on light, cut out to the page colour on dark.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Receitas, positive balance, budget within limit; as text on the surfaces and income-soft. Always paired with “+” and an up arrow.

tokens.name: income-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind income text and icons.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Despesas, negative balance, destructive actions, errors; as text on the surfaces and expense-soft. Always paired with “−” and a down arrow or a word.

tokens.name: expense-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind expense text and icons.

tokens.name: on-expense
tokens.usage: Text on an expense fill (danger button).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Budget at 80% of its limit or more; as text on the surfaces and warning-soft. Always with words (“92% do limite”).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind warning text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset; 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome screens and the one hero number per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Registre receitas e despesas em poucos segundos.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons sm, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, metadata. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: money-lg
styles.usage: Balance and invoice totals. Always with tabular-nums.

styles.name: money-md
styles.usage: Amounts in lists and cards. Always with tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; segmented-control inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; gap between buttons; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; mobile page margin; alert padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; page margin from breakpoint-md.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Header height; hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, nav items, segmented items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, alerts, segmented-control well.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, avatars, progress bars, icon discs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards (with a border hairline) and the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and segmented items in dense rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects; minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on login and mobile forms.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-column card grids start.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: page margin grows to space-6; nav shows labels.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: dashboard uses three columns.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content capped at 1200px.
